pictures.inspected: Small log hut has a steep weathered-gray gable roof, brown door at left and white-framed window at right of its gable face. The separate lower long log shed has a red hipped metal roof, broad and narrow timber doors and small end vent/panels. Trees/yard/signs remain independent context. This model is the longer red-roof equipment shed; the small gabled poultry house remains independent.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete independent equipment-shed interpretation: mapped log walls, low red metal hipped roof, three recessed weathered timber door bays, log corner ends, pale grounded plinth and supported threshold aprons. Plain small plaques retain the placement of the photo panels without copied lettering. Reuse wood_log, wood_vertical, wood_plain, metal_standing_seam, plaster_lime and metal_painted graphs. The neighboring poultry house remains a separate model; no trees, people, copied signs or photo pixels are baked in.
